emails.subject: Our Famous Churrasco & Rodizio
emails.body_html:
Discover these two legendary services.

The Authentic Brazilian Experience Your Guests Will Never Forget 🔥

Welcome to the heart of Brazilian hospitality: Churrasco and Rodizio services that transform ordinary events into extraordinary celebrations.

What is Churrasco?

Churrasco is where the magic begins – our legendary live grilling service that brings the authentic Brazilian barbecue experience directly to your event.

Watch as our skilled chefs masterfully grill premium cuts of meat right before your guests' eyes.

Fresh, perfectly cooked meats flow continuously from grill to buffet, ensuring every bite is served at the peak of flavor and temperature.

But it's more than just cooking – it's an immersive sensory journey.

The intoxicating aroma of traditional Brazilian spices fills your venue, creating an atmosphere that transports guests straight to the vibrant streets of Rio.

What is Rodizio?

If Churrasco is the foundation, Rodizio is the crown jewel – the service that has made Comeketo legendary in the catering world.

Rodizio amplifies every element of our Churrasco service and elevates it to an art form.

Picture our Gauchos gracefully moving through your event carrying impressive skewers of perfectly grilled meats.

They approach each table with the skill of master carvers, slicing fresh portions directly onto your guests' plates.

Each guest receives personal attention, with meats carved to their exact preference and doneness.

This isn't just dinner service – it's an interactive experience that becomes the centerpiece of your celebration.

The Complete Brazilian Journey

When you choose our Churrasco and Rodizio services, you're not just hiring caterers – you're bringing authentic Brazilian culture to your event.

emails.body_html:
Understanding Our Catering Services 🍽️

Which Style Is Right for Your Event?

One of the most frequent questions we receive at Comeketo is about the distinctions between our various catering styles. Each service is thoughtfully designed to create a unique dining experience that matches your event's atmosphere, budget, and guest preferences.

💼 Drop-off Catering

Perfect for casual gatherings and budget-conscious events, our drop-off service delivers restaurant-quality food directly to your venue. Choose from our economical tray presentation for intimate gatherings, or elevate the experience with elegant wire chafers and warming sternos that keep your food at the perfect temperature throughout your event.

🍴 Buffet Service

MOST POPULAR

Our most popular catering style transforms your venue into a welcoming feast where guests can explore our diverse menu at their own pace. Our experienced team arrives early to create an attractive buffet display, then remains throughout your meal service to ensure chafers stay fully stocked with fresh, hot food. We handle all breakdown and cleaning, leaving you free to enjoy your guests.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Style Service

Experience the warmth of a traditional family dinner with our family style service. We present generous, shareable platters at each table, encouraging conversation and connection as guests pass dishes and serve one another. This communal dining approach creates a cozy, home-like atmosphere that's particularly wonderful for celebrations, corporate dinners, and intimate gatherings.

🍽️ Plated Service

For those seeking an upscale, restaurant-quality dining experience, our plated service delivers individually crafted meals directly to each guest. Every plate is artfully prepared and customized to dietary preferences, creating an elegant presentation that's perfect for formal events, wedding receptions, and business dinners.

🔥 Churrasco Experience

Churrasco, meaning "Brazilian Barbecue," elevates our traditional buffet service with the excitement of live grilling. Our skilled chefs prepare fresh meats and vegetables on-site, filling the air with the intoxicating aroma of authentic Brazilian spices and seasonings. This popular upgrade transforms your event into a sensory experience that guests will remember.

⭐ Rodizio Service

OUR SIGNATURE

Our signature Rodizio service is what Comeketo is truly known for – an authentic Brazilian steakhouse experience brought directly to your event. Combined with our churrasco grilling, our Gauchos circulate throughout your venue carrying impressive skewers of perfectly grilled meats. They carve fresh portions tableside, ensuring each guest receives meat cooked to their exact preference.

Ready to Create Something Special? ✨

Contact Comeketo today to discuss which catering style will make your celebration truly unforgettable.

emails.body_html:
Understanding Our Catering Services 🍽️

Which Style Is Right for Your Event?

One of the most frequent questions we receive at Comeketo is about the distinctions between our various catering styles. Each service is thoughtfully designed to create a unique dining experience that matches your event's atmosphere, budget, and guest preferences.

💼 Drop-off Catering

Perfect for casual gatherings and budget-conscious events, our drop-off service delivers restaurant-quality food directly to your venue. Choose from our economical tray presentation for intimate gatherings, or elevate the experience with elegant wire chafers and warming sternos that keep your food at the perfect temperature throughout your event.

🍴 Buffet Service

MOST POPULAR

Our most popular catering style transforms your venue into a welcoming feast where guests can explore our diverse menu at their own pace. Our experienced team arrives early to create an attractive buffet display, then remains throughout your meal service to ensure chafers stay fully stocked with fresh, hot food. We handle all breakdown and cleaning, leaving you free to enjoy your guests.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Style Service

Experience the warmth of a traditional family dinner with our family style service. We present generous, shareable platters at each table, encouraging conversation and connection as guests pass dishes and serve one another. This communal dining approach creates a cozy, home-like atmosphere that's particularly wonderful for celebrations, corporate dinners, and intimate gatherings.

🍽️ Plated Service

For those seeking an upscale, restaurant-quality dining experience, our plated service delivers individually crafted meals directly to each guest. Every plate is artfully prepared and customized to dietary preferences, creating an elegant presentation that's perfect for formal events, wedding receptions, and business dinners.

🔥 Churrasco Experience

Churrasco, meaning "Brazilian Barbecue," elevates our traditional buffet service with the excitement of live grilling. Our skilled chefs prepare fresh meats and vegetables on-site, filling the air with the intoxicating aroma of authentic Brazilian spices and seasonings. This popular upgrade transforms your event into a sensory experience that guests will remember.

⭐ Rodizio Service

OUR SIGNATURE

Our signature Rodizio service is what Comeketo is truly known for – an authentic Brazilian steakhouse experience brought directly to your event. Combined with our churrasco grilling, our Gauchos circulate throughout your venue carrying impressive skewers of perfectly grilled meats. They carve fresh portions tableside, ensuring each guest receives meat cooked to their exact preference.

Ready to Create Something Special? ✨

Contact Comeketo today to discuss which catering style will make your celebration truly unforgettable.
